study type: quality improvement non-controlled before-and-after retrospective study
cohort: The study included 345 extremely low birth weight (ELBW) infants admitted over a 5-year period.
finding: Implementation of an anemia care bundle, combining extended subcutaneous erythropoietin administration and reduced early postnatal blood sampling, significantly reduced the rate of multiple RBC transfusions by 50% and the odds of necrotizing enterocolitis in ELBW neonates.
followup_time: Up to 8 weeks of age (for erythropoietin administration) and first five postnatal weeks (for blood sampling stewardship).
